services.title: No-Prep Porcelain Veneers
services.blurb: Patented prep-less feldspathic veneers bonded to natural enamel without grinding healthy tooth structure. Two appointments — one for digital design and provisional, one for final bonding. The result is reversible, biologically conservative, and indistinguishable from natural dentition under photography.

services.title: Same-Day Smile Design
services.blurb: Digital Smile Design preview, in-office CEREC milling lab, and ceramist-supervised glazing — full smile transformation completed in a single appointment. We do not outsource laboratory work for this service. The lab is upstairs from the operatory, staffed by a master ceramist who has worked with Dr. Davidowitz for over a decade.

services.title: Precision Dental Implants
services.blurb: Cone-beam CT-guided implant placement using surgical-stent navigation for sub-millimeter accuracy. Single-tooth and full-arch (All-on-4) protocols available. Same-day provisional restorations for visible anterior cases. Straumann and Nobel Biocare systems exclusively — both with lifetime fixture warranties.

services.title: Invisible Orthodontics
services.blurb: Invisalign Diamond+ Provider status with 20+ years of clear-aligner case experience. We handle complex bite correction and pre-prosthetic alignment that lower-volume offices refer out. Cases are planned, monitored, and refined in-house — never outsourced to a tele-dentistry vendor.

services.title: Bio-Aesthetic Whitening
services.blurb: KöR Deep Bleaching combined with custom take-home trays for the deepest, most stable whitening results clinically documented. Sensitivity-managed protocols for patients with prior whitening trauma. Maintenance regimen built around your coffee, wine, and travel reality — not generic instructions.

services.title: Full-Mouth Reconstruction
services.blurb: Comprehensive rehabilitation of worn, broken, or collapsed dentition using a phased treatment plan that respects your schedule and budget. Articulator-mounted occlusal analysis, neuromuscular dentistry principles, and laboratory-supervised provisionalization. We do not start full-mouth cases without a complete written treatment plan and second opinion welcome.

process.title: Private consultation
process.blurb: 90-minute review of medical history, occlusion, and aesthetic goals. Digital photography, CBCT scan, and intraoral scanning included — never a separate fee.

process.title: Smile preview
process.blurb: Digital Smile Design mockup or wax-up worn in-mouth so you experience the result before committing. Reversible, no preparation required.

process.title: Treatment + provisional
process.blurb: Same-day or two-visit protocol depending on case complexity. Provisional restorations are diagnostic, not placeholder — refinements made before final bonding.

process.title: Lifetime maintenance
process.blurb: Six-month hygiene cadence, annual occlusal review, and a lifetime warranty on porcelain bondings under our care.

faqs.q: How much do veneers cost in Manhattan?
faqs.a: Investment for a full smile of 8 to 10 no-prep porcelain veneers ranges from $48,000 to $72,000 depending on case complexity, ceramist selection, and the ancillary work (orthodontics, gum lifting, implant integration) required. We provide a written, line-item treatment plan after the initial consultation — never a verbal range.

faqs.q: Will my natural enamel be removed?
faqs.a: Not in our no-prep protocol. The veneers are bonded directly to existing enamel without grinding. This preserves your natural tooth structure, makes the work biologically reversible if ever needed, and produces a healthier long-term outcome than traditional aggressive-prep veneers.

faqs.q: How many visits for a full smile makeover?
faqs.a: Most cases complete in two appointments: design and provisional placement (3 hours), then final bonding (4 to 6 hours). Complex cases involving orthodontics or implant integration extend across 4 to 6 months but the cosmetic delivery itself remains a two-visit protocol.

faqs.q: Do you accept out-of-network PPO reimbursement?
faqs.a: We are out-of-network with all PPO carriers but provide full pre-authorization documentation and itemized statements for your reimbursement claim. Most patients with good PPO plans recover 30 to 50% of treatment cost. We also accept HSA/FSA payment and offer in-house financing.

faqs.q: Can you match a single chipped front tooth?
faqs.a: Yes. Single-tooth bonding and single-tooth porcelain veneer matches are technically harder than full-smile cases because the result must blend with existing teeth under every lighting condition. We use spectrophotometric color matching and on-site ceramist work for these cases — outsourcing produces compromised results.

faqs.q: How long do porcelain veneers last?
faqs.a: Properly designed and bonded feldspathic porcelain veneers typically perform for 15 to 25 years with normal wear. Pressed-ceramic and zirconia veneers can perform longer. Maintenance — twice-yearly hygiene visits and avoiding ice-chewing — is the variable, not the porcelain.

Nitrous oxide (laughing gas) at every appointment as standard. Oral conscious sedation (Halcion or Valium) for longer cases. IV sedation by visiting board-certified dental anesthesiologist for full-mouth or anxiety-managed patients. We do not perform any case in which a patient is uncomfortable.

faqs.q: Do you photograph results for my approval before bonding?
faqs.a: Always. Provisional restorations are worn for 1 to 2 weeks, photographed in your environment, and refined before final bonding. We do not bond porcelain you have not seen, lived in, and approved. Most laboratories design veneers from a single appointment — we treat the provisional phase as a diagnostic rehearsal.
